headline: Prices without brakes: inflation in September soars to 4.2%. Energy goods +22.3%. "Blow more than 10 times the savings from the car tax"
summary: Istat data show annual consumer price inflation reached 4.2% in September, with energy goods up 22.3% and a monthly rise of 0.7%. Consumer groups criticised the increase.
why: Inflation data shape European Central Bank policy expectations and the outlook for Italian government bond yields and household spending.

original_headline: Prezzi senza freni: l’inflazione a settembre vola al 4,2%. Beni energetici +22,3%. “Batosta oltre 10 volte il risparmio dovuto al bollo auto”
